data.narrative:
Exolaunch is a bootstrapped space and aerospace venture founded by Dmitriy Sternharz and Dmitriy Bogdanov, both with TU Berlin space tech backgrounds. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 6 public Space & Aerospace peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

Standard triangulation methods encounter material constraints. Peer-median pricing is not applicable: while 11 same-sector private peers exist, none satisfy narrow stage or valuation-tier filters (minimum 3 required); falling back to broad-sector medians would lack discriminatory power. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is similarly not feasible—the Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 23.9x median P/S across 6 public comps, but Exolaunch's revenue is not disclosed, as is typical for early private companies.

The absence of sufficient data points prevents a quantitative valuation range synthesis at this time. A credible analysis would require either: disclosure of Exolaunch's revenue or route-to-revenue clarity; identification of 3+ same-stage or valuation-tier private comparables with transaction data; or access to management guidance on financial metrics. Until such inputs materialize, any specific valuation figure would lack evidentiary support and should be withheld.
